name: Barksdale AFB
description: Home of Air Force Global Strike Command and the 2nd Bomb Wing. Barksdale AFB operates B-52H Stratofortress bombers and supports global strike missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Shreveport (West) Gate — Main
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with West Gate Visitor Center (0600-2200 daily). After-hours passes at gate.

gates.name: West Gate Visitor Center
gates.address: Wilbur Wright Dr, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110

gates.name: Industrial (East) Gate
gates.notes: Commercial and limited passenger access. East VCC Mon-Fri 0600-1745.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Barksdale Inn (318-456-3091) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 2 FSS, M&FRC, and official Barksdale sites for in-processing and Global Strike Command support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
